name: PrefixStream S5: repaint the S1 render as watercolor, each box following its own slice of @video1

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hand-drawn 2D animation in soft watercolor, following the framing, camera, motion and timing of @video1 exactly. Medium close-up, static camera. A sunlit kitchen in the morning; she stands behind a wooden counter with a bowl of lemons, window light from the left. The woman (S1), a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length dark hair, a green knit sweater and small gold earrings, speaking warmly to camera in a calm, conversational tone, says: <d>[English] Good morning. Today I want to show you how I make my grandmother's lemon cake.</d> She smiles and rests her hands on the counter.

overall_soundscape: Her clear voice close to the microphone, soft kitchen room tone, a faint clock ticking.
